items.title: Which Number Is Sticky? What Survives Source Withdrawal in Sequential LLM Financial Analysis
items.claim: Controlling display of prior valuations matters more than disclosing their withdrawal in LLM financial analysis.

items.title: Correlated Beliefs, Correlated Trades: Agentic AI and Endogenous Volatility Amplification
